navbar.notes: navy-900 64px top bar, 2px brand-red bottom border, shadow-navbar; navbar__brand (navbar__icon warehouse.png + 'StockFlow') left, navbar__links right; navbar__link--active in brand red

app_icon.notes: warehouse.png at --icon-brand; same asset is the favicon; page__icon variant in page__header

page.notes: warm-oat bg, centered 960px column; page__header with page__icon + page__title, page__subtitle

card.notes: white, --radius-lg, --shadow-sm, --space-6 padding, hover lift to --shadow-md; card__title

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand, radius 0), btn--secondary (outlined navy-200), btn--ghost, btn--danger, btn--danger-outline, btn--sm; is-loading shows btn__spinner + disabled

form_field.notes: field__label persistent, field__input (focus ring --color-info), field--error (error border + error-light fill), field__error inline field-named message, field__hint

form.notes: single narrow column inside a card; form__actions row with primary CTA

stock_table.notes: cool uppercase --text-xs header; stock-table__num right-aligned mono tabular-nums; stock-table__row--flash success-light in-place update flash

status_badge.variants: badge--in-stock (success), badge--low (warning), badge--out (error), badge--on-order (info), badge--quarantined (navy), badge--not-tracked (cool/tertiary)
status_badge.notes: pill, --text-xs uppercase, text always present (never color alone)

empty_state.notes: empty-state__icon (48px) + empty-state__title + empty-state__body teaching copy + CTA; never a blank region

toast.notes: toast-region fixed top-right, aria-live; no layout shift

alert.notes: inline, role=alert; reserved for page-load failure + validation summary

scan_zone.notes: primary barcode input area, large mono input, dashed navy-300 border; flash via --transition-base

confirmation.notes: post-submit success view: success icon + heading + summary + next-action buttons

detail_list.notes: SKU detail key/value rows; detail-list__value--muted for 'not tracked'

loading.notes: explicit loading state: spinner + 'Loading…' text, aria-busy
